verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs say it reviews every PR 'with complete understanding of your codebase' and maintains a synthesized knowledge base per enrolled repository. Existing conventions feed into reviews through indexed rule files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, cursor.rules), imported AI rules, custom standards and style guides. Older community tests show some real cross-file grounding (pointing to the right Rails file), but also incomplete answers on C++ templates, which tempers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that reviews trace call sites and related modules beyond the diff, and independent hands-on corroboration that review comments specifically reflect repo-wide context.
